title: Yennai Arindhaal
desc: Sathyadev, an honest police officer, is on a mission to stop an organ trafficking racket, unaware that the mastermind is the same person who killed his beloved.

title: Kaashmora
desc: Kaashmora, a fraudster, gets locked inside a haunted bungalow, along with his clan. Soon, the family faces an army of ghosts who will let them leave only if their wishes are granted.

title: Pasanga 2
desc: Kavin and Naina are expelled from several schools due to their hyperactive behaviour. Their frustrated parents accidentally meet Thamizh, a psychiatrist, who becomes a saviour for their children.

title: Avvai Shanmugi
desc: After losing custody of his daughter by trying to abduct her from her mother, Pandiyan disguises himself as an elderly female caretaker to be close to her.

title: Vaseegara
desc: Bhupathi's father sends him to live under the guidance of his best friend, Viswanath, and find a job. He gets close to the family and falls in love with Viswanath's daughter, who is already engaged.
